title: Portal or wormhole theory for the ranch
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Portal or wormhole theory for the ranch, about 2016-2026 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> When Dr. Taylor and others speculate that there's a portal for portals or wormholes on Skinwalker Ranch,

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, talks about an idea put forward by a scientist he calls Dr. Taylor and others. According to Fugal, they speculate that there may be a portal or a wormhole, a kind of shortcut through space, on the ranch. If true, it would explain the odd events people report there as things coming and going from somewhere else.
